_doc: Per-page data and slot requirements for the Genome Atlas. Round 1 declares all ten planned pages (one per major spec); requires_layers / requires_slots / preloads are stubbed empty because none of the pages has a renderer yet — they're scaffold specs. Each page's _doc captures what the page will read once its phase ships.
_round1_status: Eight pages declared as scaffolds (post-2026-05-19 meiosis carve-out). Real requires_* are added per page as renderers wire in (phase B+). The former page_crossovers + page_nco_gc entries moved to meiosis-atlas (see _migration_note below).
_migration_note_2026_05_19: page_crossovers and page_nco_gc moved to meiosis-atlas on 2026-05-19 (per KICKOFF_meiosis_atlas.md), where they live as `crossovers_per_candidate` and `nco_per_candidate` under the meiosis 'hub' stage. Per-candidate meiosis views belong in the Meiosis Atlas (cohort discipline: meiosis runs on the F₁×F₁ progeny, not the F₁ hybrid the rest of genome-atlas describes). page_chromosome_overview's CO-density sub-track now reads the meiosis-owned crossover_track layer cross-atlas.

page_scaffold._doc: Static landing page. Six sections: vision, required data layers (eight chips, all '⚪ not loaded' in round 1), chromosome-overview mockup (gradient stand-ins for real density tracks), planned-panel inventory, phasing roadmap (A → E), cross-references to the three sibling atlases. SCHEMA §28. Round-1 status: stub-preserving + lifecycle scaffolding — mount() builds a no-op _pageState; unmount() clears it. Renderer hook (refreshPage1) is a no-op pending phase B+.

page_assembly_stats._doc: Headline assembly QC: BUSCO single-copy %, contig/scaffold N50, gap rate, T2T completeness, total length. Six global tiles + a per-chromosome QC table (chrom × haplotype, with centromere/telomere status, T2T chip). Phase B wires assembly_stats + centromere_telomere layers. Future requires_layers: ['assembly_stats', 'centromere_telomere'].

page_chromosome_overview._doc: Primary phase-B deliverable. One row per chromosome, length-scaled across the page. Stacked sub-tracks: base bar (with centromere overlay), gene density, repeat density, conserved-element density, CO density (sex-collapsed, from crossover_track; clicking pivots to page_crossovers for the active candidate), cohort overlay (L2 envelopes + candidates from the Inversion Atlas). Mirrors scrubber width so the two atlases can be stacked. Future requires_layers: ['chromosome_map', 'gene_track', 'repeat_track', 'conserved_elements', 'centromere_telomere', 'crossover_track']. Future requires_slots: ['activeChrom', 'candidate'] (cross-atlas reads).

page_assembly_methods._doc: Pure documentation page describing the HiFi + Hi-C + ONT haplotype-resolved assembly pipeline. Five stages from raw reads to curated FAI+AGP. No data layers, no renderer. Ships round 1 in its final shape; no phase B/C upgrade planned beyond text edits.

page_genes._doc: Three views: (1) genome-wide gene-density bar chart, one bar per chrom; (2) per-chrom gene track (boxes + introns) on a length-scaled axis driven by activeChrom; (3) gene cargo per inversion candidate — for every promoted candidate, list genes inside the span, sorted by SnpEff impact when variant_annotations is loaded. Bridges the assembly paper to the Inversion Atlas. Future requires_layers: ['gene_track', 'chromosome_map', 'variant_annotations']. Future requires_slots: ['activeChrom', 'candidateList'].

page_repeats_te._label: repeats / TE — landscape and breakpoint enrichment
page_repeats_te._doc: Three views: per-class composition (LTR / LINE / SINE / DNA / simple / unclassified), per-chrom density heatmap, breakpoint enrichment per inversion candidate using the Spalax-style focal-vs-bg widget (same widget the Inversion Atlas uses on page16). Future requires_layers: ['repeat_track', 'chromosome_map']. Future requires_slots: ['candidateList'].

page_variant_annotations._doc: Phase E (final piece of the Genome Atlas). SnpEff / VEP impact category overlay per inversion candidate. Three views: per-candidate impact tally table, compact impact bar (HIGH/MODERATE/LOW/MODIFIER), expandable HIGH-impact variant list. Depends on MODULE_CONSERVATION cluster-side deliverables (VESM / SIFT4G / SnpEff / GERP++). Future requires_layers: ['variant_annotations', 'gene_track']. Future requires_slots: ['candidateList'].

page_conserved_elements._doc: Phase C–D. UCE + phastCons regulatory-disruption overlay per inversion candidate. Three views: per-chrom element tick strip, per-candidate UCE overlap table, continuous phastCons score profile. Complements page_genes (gene cargo) by counting regulatory hits. Future requires_layers: ['conserved_elements', 'synteny_blocks']. Future requires_slots: ['activeChrom', 'candidateList'].

page_synteny._label: synteny — Cactus pairwise blocks + macrosyntR Oxford grid
page_synteny._doc: Phase D. Cross-species collinearity for Cgar vs related Siluriformes (Cmac, I. punctatus, plus 7-9 more via catfish-synteny-toolkit wfmash). Four views: (1) pairwise ribbon (one species pair); (2) multi-species ribbon stack; (3) per-chrom dotplot; (4) macrosyntR-style Oxford grid — aggregated chrom-pair view, one dot per (chrom_a × chrom_b) cell, dot size ∝ shared-ortholog count, colour ∝ BH-q (large blue ≤ q_hi=0.01, small yellow ≤ q_lo=0.05, blank otherwise). Focal genomes A/B are toggleable from the page; on change the renderer fetches data/comparative/oxford/<a>_<b>.json. Hover surfaces chrom_a · chrom_b · n_orthologs · q. Inversions render as anti-parallel polygons in View 1; translocations as chrom-jumping polygons. Ties to Inversion Atlas page16 cross-species breakpoint catalogue. Future requires_layers: ['synteny_blocks', 'chromosome_map', 'synteny_oxford_grid']. Future requires_slots: ['activeChrom'].

page_ancestral_karyotype._doc: Phase D. Ancestral karyotype panel + phylogeny-with-events + per-element descent map. Same Cactus output as page_synteny, viewed phylogenetically rather than pairwise. Likely promoted to a Supplementary Note in the assembly paper. Future requires_layers: ['synteny_blocks', 'chromosome_map'].

pages._meiosis_pages_moved: page_crossovers and page_nco_gc — see _migration_note_2026_05_19 at top of file. Owned by meiosis-atlas from 2026-05-19.

page_orthologues._doc: Phase D. Three tables comparing one focal genome against every non-focal genome in the comparison set: (1) summary table — one row per non-focal, counts of 1:1 / 1:n / m:1 / m:n + focal-orphan + non-focal-orphan, % mapped; (2) per focal-chrom breakdown — one row per focal chrom, one column per non-focal with %1:1 conservation, cells green/amber/red on configurable thresholds (default ≥90 / 65–90 / <65); (3) gene-level explorer — one row per focal gene with ortholog ids (or '—') for each non-focal, copy count as superscript on 1:n, filterable by gene-id prefix, paginated. Focal genome is selectable and reads/writes shared.focalGenome (synced with page_synteny's Oxford-grid row axis). Future requires_layers: ['ortholog_tables', 'chromosome_map']. Optional future requires_layers: ['ortholog_pairs']. Future requires_slots: ['focalGenome']. JSON import contract: one `ortholog_tables.json` per FOCAL genome at `data/comparative/orthologs/<focal_id>.json` carrying { focal{id,label,assembly,gene_count,chroms[]}, non_focal[{id,label,assembly,gene_count,summary{one_to_one,one_to_many,many_to_one,many_to_many,focal_orphans,nonfocal_orphans},per_focal_chrom[{chrom,pct_one_to_one}]}], thresholds?{pct_good,pct_mid}, source_pipeline? }. Optional companion `ortholog_pairs.json` per (focal × non-focal) at `data/comparative/orthologs/pairs/<focal>_<nonfocal>.json` for View 3 — lazy-loaded on column reveal. Both schemas embedded on the page.

page_comparative_te._label: comparative TE — Chapter 5 ingest (17 catfish genomes)
page_comparative_te._doc: 17-species TE landscape. Five views driven by fixtures/chapter5/consolidated.json: abundance bars (te_abundance), Kimura age landscape (kimura_landscape), Cgar centromere context (centromeres_cgar), ALG collinearity heatmap (alg_collinearity), breakpoint × TE cross (breakpoint_te_cross). Phase D — wires when the cluster pipeline lands the equivalent atlases/genome/data/comparative/te/consolidated.json file.

page_haplotype_synteny._label: haplotype synteny — focal Gar↔Mac wfmash alignment
page_haplotype_synteny._doc: Focal F1-haplotype whole-genome alignment. Reads fixtures/haplotype_synteny/synteny_blocks.json (schema v2 from STEP_CS01_extract_breakpoints.py); renders ribbons per Gar chrom, focal Oxford dotplot, and the LG28↔(LG06+LG01) fusion/fission event panel — the sequence-level signature of the n=28 vs n=27 karyotype difference. Cross-species panel work lives elsewhere (page_synteny multi-species + the separate cross-species atlas).
